note: Four frames: two pane with a gate waiting, decision made, the review sheet, on cellular. Nothing of the tablet exists (S3.5), so every element is missing with that reason; the phone app is where the tablet will live, hence the sources. The cellular frame reaches the machine over Domovoi Cloud, which is Phase 2, so it is blocked rather than missing. Evidence for the missing elements names the components the tablet will introduce under apps/mobile/src (TabletSessionsPane, TabletThreadHeader, TabletThread, TabletGateCard, TabletReceipt, TabletComposer, TabletReviewSheet); an implementer who names them differently updates the evidence in the same change.
sample: Migrate billing webhooks to the new idempotency table
Webhooks get delivered twice when Stripe retries. Fix it properly, tests included.
Claim-then-commit is in, on a replay table keyed by event id. One spec still asserts the old at-least-once behaviour. Step 3 needs a migration on this machine, so I stopped and asked.
One row per Stripe event id. The unique key is the claim, so a second delivery cannot insert.
